provenance.numeric_scope: All AI thresholds, counts, durations and ordering here are LOCAL design defaults, not verified original game rules.

integration.scope: Stage 4 attack-one / stage 5 heal-one and buff-one policy data only; no runtime change or formal PASS.
integration.future_consumer: Existing CompanionAI and shared world scheduler; CompanionRecord remains sole companion HP/MP ledger.
integration.existing_state_difference: Existing ATTACK denotes basic attack intent; the seven design states below describe future spell policy and do not replace current code.

hp.comparison: Enter at <= enter threshold; remain latched until >= exit threshold. Invalid or unknown HP/maxHP is UNKNOWN, not zero.

mp.actual_cost_definition: C_heal and C_candidate are the authoritative caster-specific total MP debit for the selected learned spell after applicable modifiers, not a guessed catalog base cost.
mp.reserve_eligibility: C_heal must be known, nonnegative and coupled to learned status, caster/target eligibility, actual materials and cooldown. Cooldown or temporary range/LOS failure does not reduce R to zero. Unknown C_heal or heal contract makes R UNKNOWN and blocks non-emergency spells.
mp.non_emergency_admission: current_mp - C_candidate >= R, plus actual materials, cooldown, range, LOS and target eligibility. Buffs and attacks use the same admission rule.
mp.emergency_admission: May spend R; current_mp >= C_heal plus actual materials, cooldown, range, LOS and target eligibility are still required.
mp.recover_resume_formula: T = max(R + C_next_attack, ceil(recover_fraction * max_mp)); resume offense only when current_mp >= T and all current eligibility checks pass.
mp.unreachable_threshold: If R or T exceeds max_mp, retain reserve and keep offense disabled; do not clamp reserve away or refill MP. A valid emergency heal may still spend available MP.
mp.recovery_authority: Observe actual CompanionRecord MP changes from the shared recovery consumer; this table neither grants MP nor promises recovery cadence/amount.

buff.unit: seconds of authoritative server effect time
buff.refresh_formula: lead = min(refresh_lead_cap_seconds, duration_seconds * refresh_lead_duration_fraction); refresh only when absent or remaining_seconds <= lead.
buff.rearm_rule: After confirmed successful refresh, suppress duplicate requests for that spell/target/effect instance until refreshed remaining time > lead + hysteresis, or authoritative expiry/removal. A short effect that cannot reach that band rearms only after confirmed expiry/removal. No stacking inferred.
buff.unknown_duration_or_effect: Disable refresh when duration, current expiry, effect identity or refresh/stacking semantics is UNKNOWN; absence alone cannot authorize an unverified effect.

failure.rule: One failed admission/cast per unchanged reason and eligibility snapshot; rearm only after a relevant authoritative change and minimum_retry_seconds. No per-tick failure loop.

movement.unit: world tiles; LOCAL existing AI defaults
movement.speed: Use admitted companion movement/cast intervals; no invented animation, attack speed or spell range.

priorities.meaning: Cancel pending intent on companion death, dismissal, owner death/logout/map departure or stale actor generation before any support/combat.

Eligible owner first, then companion when both emergency latches are set. Skip a currently ineligible target after one failed evaluation so it cannot starve an eligible other target. Never heal dead targets.
Find a passable, unoccupied tile respecting owner leash and current map. A blocked emergency heal may request bounded POSITION here, not repeated CAST.
Only the selected, learned, eligible buff with verified effect/expiry and preserved heal reserve.
Current real ASSIST target only, eligible selected attack spell and preserved heal reserve.
Follow owner or remain HOLD; wait for actual resource recovery. Unsupported/failed support must fall through instead of monopolizing ticks.

FOLLOW.meaning: Follow current owner when outside follow distance.

HOLD.meaning: No movement, including spell positioning. In-range support and ASSIST remain candidates.

to.RECOVER: insufficient MP while preserving HOLD command

POSITION.meaning: Bounded path toward a safe casting tile using actual spell range/LOS. HOLD forbids entry.

to.CAST: range/LOS and all admission checks now pass
to.RETURN: budget/step limit, blocked path, leash or obsolete attack target

CAST.meaning: One admitted action bound to caster, target generation, map and current command; revalidate at commit.

to.POSITION: range/LOS fails before commit with movement permitted
to.RETURN: target invalidated or bounded positioning fails

RECOVER.meaning: No offensive casting; eligible urgent heal may interrupt. FOLLOW may move safely; HOLD remains stationary.

to.CAST: eligible urgent heal or offense reaches T with all checks

RETURN.meaning: Drop failed combat pursuit and return toward owner with existing movement limits; HOLD waits in place. Never teleport.

DEAD.meaning: All movement/cast/attack timers and target references cancelled; no automatic resurrection.

to.FOLLOW: separate authorized resurrection and fresh summon establishes a living actor

state_transitions.global_cancel: Dismissal/owner departure invalidates all states and removes the runtime actor through existing lifecycle; DISMISSED is a lifecycle outcome, not an eighth AI state.

stage_5_heal.eligibility: Living same-map current owner/self only after catalog target/caster contract is confirmed; source selection does not grant spell learning.

stage_5_buff.eligibility: Official catalog target is caster only; never apply Shield to owner. Unknown runtime caster/effect contract still disables execution.

assist.trigger: Real owner attack event selects its living hostile NPC target immediately and wakes the shared scheduler; each real owner target change replaces the previous target.
assist.cooldowns: Keep earned movement/attack/cast deadlines across target or command changes; immediate selection does not bypass cooldown or preempt an already committed action.
assist.retarget_cancel: Cancel uncommitted old-target offense/position intent. A committed spell resolves once under its original target/lifetime contract, never duplicated onto the new target.
assist.eligibility: Same-map current-generation hostile monster only; reject allies, owner, companion, dead or stale targets. PASSIVE forbids offensive selection.

spell_selection.other_spells: Unselected; no automatic highest-level spell expansion, AoE, damage-over-time or effect substitution.

cast_and_lifetime.admission: Requires catalog admission for spell key, learned/class/level, actual MP/material cost, caster UID treatment, effect and target notification; any unresolved required contract keeps that spell disabled.
cast_and_lifetime.once_only_cost: AI produces intent only. Existing authoritative cast consumer alone applies actual MP/material debit, cooldown and effect at its admitted once-only commit point; AI never debits, refunds or replays cost. A committed or unknown result must be reconciled before another attempt.
cancel_on: command change incompatible with pending action
cast_and_lifetime.cancel_semantics: Cancel uncommitted intent/timer without consuming resources; cancellation after commit cannot erase debit/effect. Resolve or preserve uncertain outcomes without resend/refund.
cast_and_lifetime.persistent: Persist commands, configured absolute mp_reserve, learned spells and actual HP/MP in existing character/companion ownership. No parallel HP/MP store.
cast_and_lifetime.reconnect: Do not persist actor UID/generation, target, pending cast, timer handle, emergency latch or positioning/retry deadline. Logout cancels old runtime; restore resources/settings and create fresh actor only by normal summon, then reevaluate actual effects and eligibility. No free MP, cooldown reset or resurrection; unresolved committed actions require reconciliation.
cast_and_lifetime.effect_lifetime: Authoritative effect consumer owns expiry/removal/save/restore. Disconnect does not imply buff refund or perpetual duration.

fallbacks.heal_mp_or_material_failure: RECOVER/follow-or-HOLD, suppress same failure until actual MP/material/learning/cooldown change and retry throttle; try another currently eligible emergency target once. Do not manufacture resources.
fallbacks.heal_range_or_los_failure: Bounded safe POSITION if FOLLOW; otherwise HOLD and fall through. After exhausted positioning, wait for actual owner/actor/terrain change with throttle; no endless chasing or casting.
fallbacks.attack_range_or_los_failure: POSITION within budget; then abandon pursuit/RETURN. Same ASSIST target requires new relevant geometry/owner-attack event plus throttle before another positioning attempt.
fallbacks.unknown_spell_or_growth: No inferred learned spells, costs, range, effects, maxMP or recovery. Disable affected spell selection; preserve movement/basic attack behavior only when separately admitted by existing runtime.
fallbacks.unknown_cost_outcome: Preserve partial state and reconcile once-only result before retries; never assume a failed response means no spend.

unknown: Runtime catalog consumer and spell-cast intent/effect wiring are not implemented by this table.
Original companion caster UID, per-target effect notification, native cost/consumption and visible original-client behavior remain independently unverified.
Current mage_spells catalog admission and growth/recovery consumers must supply actual costs, learned eligibility and resources; reference existence alone does not admit a spell.
